finding: Invalid direct shopping entry showed a message without moving focus to the invalid input or marking/describing that input
changes: Name/quantity/unit refs route validation failure to corresponding input after DOM error renders
Field-specific aria-invalid and error described-by linkage
Unrelated field edits retain the current error; editing the implicated field clears it
12px error copy and explicit themed error border

validation.shopping_mutations: none; every attempted addition failed frontend validation

limits: Current connected iPhone/light and invalid-entry cases only
No valid add, quantity update, checkbox or delete executed
Other device/layout and server-error cases remain separate evidence
